'''Kitten''' is an [[enemy]]. It is a juvenile cat, and serves as a weak, early game enemy mainly found in [[Act 1]].

{{mb|Maisie}} starts the fight with 5 of them summoned. 

Can be acquired as a [[familiar]] through {{Event|Stray Cat!}} or {{i|Ball of Yarn}}.

== Behavior ==
Melee attacker, will walk to its enemies and stay close to them.

Uses standard {{a|Melee Attack}} as its basic attack.

When hit, runs away as far as it can from its enemies.

=== Tips ===
* Try to kill it in one hit, as having it constantly running away can drag out a battle.
* Alternatively this running away behavior can be exploited by longer-range classes to protect allies that it may attack by moving it out of range.
* {{i|Blackjack}} activates whenever it tries to attack a cat holding the weapon, making it run away without the cat getting hit.

== Trivia ==
* They use a 2.0 pitch female2 [[voice]] for cats.
* Kittens run away from damage like cats with the {{d|Anxiety}} disorder.
